**Summary:** None of the three standing rules fired this morning, so I placed no orders. R2 required a confirmed takeover offer for AAPL above the market price, and the feed contained no AAPL news whatsoever — no headline, notice, or corporate action — with AAPL trading at 222.70. R3 required MSFT to fall more than 15%, but MSFT was actually higher by 0.3–0.6% across all three venues at 420.18. Each condition was checked against multiple independent venues as required, and in every case the venues agreed, so there was no ambiguity to resolve. The account is unchanged: $50,000 cash and 100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK, 100 TER.
